common.offline: Awukho kwi-intanethi. Oku kufuna uqhagamshelwano; kuza kusebenza kwakhona xa ubuyile.

onboarding.documentTitle: Hlawula nayiphi na ispaza ngayo nayiphi na iwalethi
onboarding.body: Yamkela iintlawulo nge-QR code kuphela. Akukho matshini wamakhadi, isebenzisa idatha encinci kakhulu, kwaye iyaqhubeka isebenza nokuba inethiwekhi iyaphela.

wallet.fullHint: Iqala ngo-$ okanye ngo-https://. Yifumane kwi-app yewalethi yakho.

poster.title: Iphosta yakho ye-QR
poster.hint: Yiprinte nge-A5 uyibeke apho abathengi banokuyiskena khona.
poster.anyWallet: Ngayo nayiphi na iwalethi ye-Open Payments

unauthorized.title: Le fowuni iphumile kwivenkile

empty.title: Akukho thebhu zivuliweyo
